CollatzWork.Disproof.BranchingCenter.cen: Induct on the first exponent and split on whether the second is zero. If exactly one exponent is zero, the equality would make an odd factor even. If both are positive, cancel a common factor of two and apply the induction hypothesis; the two zero exponents give equality of the odd factors directly. CollatzWork.Disproof.BranchingCenter.bra: Factor the equation as 2^b(2^c+3)=2^a(2^b+3). Positivity of b and c makes the parenthesized factors odd. Odd-part uniqueness gives b=a and equality of those factors. Removing the common three gives 2^c=2^b, and odd-part uniqueness with odd factor one gives c=b. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/Disproof/BranchingCenter.lean#L88-L113
CollatzWork.Disproof.FiniteResidueFirstI: Apply invariance under A at A′(x) and use A(A′(x))=x to derive invariance under A′; do the same for B′. Compose the four invariance equalities to obtain invariance under F. Induction gives invariance under every nonnegative iterate, and the reachability hypothesis then equates the values at any two points. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/Disproof/FiniteResidueFirstIntegral.lean#L96-L109
CollatzWork.Disproof.noNonresonantConten: The odd-part normal-form theorem applied to the displayed equality gives H=3^(dQ). Coprimality of p with three implies coprimality of p^E with 3^(dQ). If p^E divides H, a coprime divisor must equal one, contradicting p>1 and E>0. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/Disproof/PolynomialRatchet.lean#L98-L117
CollatzWork.Disproof.quotientDegreesVani: Induct on the list. For a nonempty list, the natural-number equation head+tail-sum=0 forces both terms to be zero. The head case is immediate and entries in the tail vanish by the induction hypothesis. Source: https://github.com/Sodelin/Collatz-Conjecture-Work/blob/026aa4ad4be6453a005ab950b160a9f2204c5271/lean/CollatzWork/Disproof/PolynomialRatchet.lean#L119-L136
CollatzWork.Disproof.twoPumpCoefficientD: Expand the four coefficient formulas and distribute multiplication. CollatzWork.Disproof.twoPumpConstantObst: Use the coefficient dependencies aB=cC and gA=dE. Reassociate cgAC as c(gA)C, replace gA by dE, then replace cC by aB.
